meta.name: tdd-workflow
meta.description: Use this skill when writing new features, fixing bugs, or refactoring code. Enforces test-driven development with 80%+ coverage including unit, integration, and E2E tests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用测试驱动开发新功能、修复缺陷或重构代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果坚持测试驱动开发并追求高覆盖率
copy.tagline_en: Drive development with tests for new features, bug fixes, or refactoring
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you practice test-driven development and aim for high coverage

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会强制先写测试再写代码，确保代码覆盖率达到 80% 以上，包括单元、集成和端到端测试。
howto.when: 当你要求编写新功能、修复 bug 或重构代码时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 TDD 方式写一个搜索市场的功能。
say.note: Claude 会先写测试用例，再实现代码。

say.text: 修复这个 bug，但先写测试。
say.note: Claude 会先编写失败测试，再修复代码。

say.text: 重构这个组件，保持测试通过。
say.note: Claude 会先运行测试，再重构，确保不破坏功能。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will enforce writing tests before code, ensuring at least 80% coverage including unit, integration, and E2E tests.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to write new features, fix bugs, or refactor code.

say_en.text: Help me write a search markets feature using TDD.
say_en.note: Claude will write test cases first, then implement.

say_en.text: Fix this bug, but write tests first.
say_en.note: Claude will write failing tests, then fix code.

say_en.text: Refactor this component while keeping tests green.
say_en.note: Claude will run tests first, then refactor safely.
